subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` and `CommandQueueEnqueueOptions.onTaskTimeout` after the persistence-ordering defects are repaired?
rationale: The session-state repairs are mechanical, but the operator configuration and generic queue callback are durable product and API contracts that require maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after lifecycle fixes
options.body: Approve both opt-in contracts after file-backed and SQLite mutation ordering is safe and upgrade behavior remains unchanged by default.

options.title: Narrow to existing policy
options.body: Reuse an existing timeout policy and keep timeout fencing private to context-engine maintenance rather than expanding shared contracts.

options.title: Pause contract expansion
options.body: Do not land the timeout surfaces until maintainers settle the owner boundary and operator policy.

recommendation.title: Accept after lifecycle fixes
recommendation.body: Approve both opt-in contracts after file-backed and SQLite mutation ordering is safe and upgrade behavior remains unchanged by default.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest main commit owns the current maintenance, transcript, and queue-timeout lifecycle that these proposed contracts extend.
